name: PT6314
description: Princeton PT6314 character VFD (SPI). Each write is a start byte then an Instruction or Data byte (Zephyr auxdisplay_pt6314). Function Set BR1:BR0 sets brightness. Entry_Mode / Display_Control / Function_Set / DDRAM_AC mirror the last decoded commands.

registers.name: Start
registers.description: Last SPI start byte. Bits 7:3 must be 11111 (sync); bit2=R/W (0=write); bit1=RS (0=Instruction, 1=Data). Zephyr write-instruction uses 0xF8, write-data uses 0xFA.

fields.name: SYNC
fields.description: Must be 0b11111 for a valid serial start byte.

registers.name: Instruction
registers.description: Instruction register (IR), written when RS=0. Command classes by high bits: 0x01 clear, 0x02 home, 0x04 entry mode, 0x08 display on/off, 0x10 cursor/display shift, 0x20 function set (includes brightness), 0x40 set CGRAM addr, 0x80 set DDRAM addr.

fields.name: SET_DDRAM
fields.description: 1 = Set DDRAM address; bits 6:0 are the address (line 0 base 0x00, line 1 base 0x40).

fields.name: FUNCTION
fields.description: When bits7:6=00: 1 = Function Set (DL / N / brightness).

fields.name: D
fields.description: Display on — meaningful when the write is Display Control (0x08|flags).

registers.name: Data
registers.description: Data register (DR), written when RS=1. Bytes go to DDRAM (character code) or CGRAM at the current address; the address then steps per Entry Mode.

fields.name: CHAR
fields.description: Character code (0x20–0x7E printable ASCII) or one CGRAM pattern row.

registers.name: Entry_Mode
registers.description: Decoded Entry Mode Set (0x04|I/D|S). Datasheet reset is I/D=1, S=0.

fields.name: I_D
fields.description: Increment (1) or decrement (0) DDRAM after each Data write.

fields.name: S
fields.description: Shift the entire display when the address moves.

registers.name: Display_Control
registers.description: Decoded Display On/Off Control (0x08|D|C|B). Datasheet power-on leaves D=C=B=0 (display off).

registers.name: Function_Set
registers.description: Decoded Function Set (0x20|DL|N|X|BR1|BR0). Datasheet reset is 0x38 (8-bit, 2-line, 100% brightness). Zephyr maps brightness 1–4 onto BR1:BR0 as 25%/50%/75%/100%.

fields.name: DL
fields.description: Interface data length (parallel modes; serial always 8-bit).

registers.name: DDRAM_AC
registers.description: Decoded DDRAM address counter. Peek is 0x80|AC; poke issues Set DDRAM Address. Line 0 is 0x00–0x27, line 1 is 0x40–0x67 (40×2 internal); the visible viewport is columns × rows from DT.
